## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：市场应用详情页点「安装」（装进本运行时）不再立刻开装，先弹控制台自己的确认框，写明会加入几个对象、几个权限集、几条示例记录，以及装后会建议把哪个权限集授予所有已登录用户；确认框里再点「安装」照原样安装，「取消」什么都不装。示例数据仍默认加载。
- 为什么改：#30325 实测：HotCRM 一点安装就直接 处理中…，一次加了几十个对象、权限集和 369 条示例记录，管理员事先看不到。
- 风险与回滚：只改前端；数字取自页面原本就在读的同一份版本 manifest（install-local 实际安装的也是它），不新增请求；读不到 manifest 时确认框如实说读不到，安装照常可用。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/installPreview.ts`（计数口径）、`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` 的 `doInstallLocal` / `runInstallLocal` 与新 `AlertDialog`、`marketplaceApi.ts` 的 `getServedPackageBody`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installPreview-30325.test.tsx packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/installPreview-30325.test.ts`，预期 12 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **The confirm.** The package page's local Install (`doInstallLocal`) now opens an `AlertDialog` instead of posting at once. It names the package, then lists **Objects / Permission sets / Sample records** as label and number, a note that sample records load with the app and can be cleared from this page afterwards, and one line per permission set the install will suggest granting to Everyone (nothing is granted until an administrator accepts). Its **Install** calls `runInstallLocal`, the unchanged install body (modes, result notes, refusals all as before); **Cancel** installs nothing. Reinstall gets the same confirm with a reinstall title. One click on the confirm's Install continues as today.
- **Where the counts come from** (`installPreview.ts`, a pure reader). The page already read `GET /api/v1/marketplace/packages/:id/versions/latest/manifest` for `installModes`; that body is what install-local fetches and installs. `marketplaceApi.ts` now exposes the body read (`getServedPackageBody`) and the mode reader as a pure function (`declaredInstallModesOf`), and the page derives both the modes and the preview from the ONE read. The counts follow the door's own reading of that body:
  - package bodies: nested `manifest:` flattened beside the collections, plus each `packages[]` entry's body;
  - objects: `objects` as a list or a name-keyed map;
  - permission sets: `permissions` only when it is a LIST of named sets (the manifest-stage capability grant is an object and is not counted);
  - sample records: top-level `data[]` entries with an `object` and a `records` list, summed (the server's `seedDatasetsOf` filter, the datasets the install's seed step loads). A dataset scoped by `env` (not all three) or `locale` may not load here, so the value then reads "up to N";
  - suggested grants: permission sets declaring `isDefault: true` (ADR-0090 D5).
- **Sample-record count, read one way with #30323.** Before install: the declared seed records above. After install: #30323's `sampleRecordsLoaded` reads the install answer's `seeded`. Agreed with that card's thread; this PR does not touch its files.
- **Unreadable manifest.** The confirm says what the package adds could not be read and the install result will say what loaded; its Install still installs.
- **Strings.** `marketplace.install.preview.*` (11 keys) in all 10 packs; no existing key changes. `atMost` is named on the count-neutral list of `count-families-11445.test.ts` (the number stands after "up to", the noun is the row label). The de pack uses no „…“ span, so `de-quote-pairing-3876.test.ts` is unchanged.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/30325-install-confirm-what-it-adds.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

Branch: the harness-assigned `claude/project-thread-o1qmt2`, not `claude/issue-30325-*`; the card is #30325.

## Tests

- New `MarketplacePackagePage.installPreview-30325.test.tsx` (6 cases, real `marketplaceApi` over a stubbed `fetch`): Install opens the confirm with 3 objects / 2 sets / 9 records and the `crm_user` suggestion, with zero install POSTs and ONE manifest GET; its Install posts once and the success note is drawn; Cancel posts nothing; a locale-scoped dataset reads "up to 6"; no records and no default set draw no note and no suggestion line; a 404 manifest says unreadable and Install still posts.
- New `installPreview-30325.test.ts` (6 cases): flattened bundle, capability-grant `permissions` not counted, multi-package artifact, env/locale upper bound, skipped seed entries, non-body null.
- Existing local-install tests click the confirm after Install: `credentialStep-27238`, `dependencyMissing-25792`, `installMode-12288`, `protocolCheckSkipped-30326`, `servedTruth-12098`, `walledCatalogPackageRefusal-7611`. No assertion changed.
- Positive control: `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx` restored to the base (`fa9c0aa2`) with the new tests kept: 6 failed / 6; restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, blob hash matches HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- **Live, real stack.** Showcase `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` with `OS_CLOUD_URL` pointed at a local stand-in control plane serving one catalog package and its flattened bundle (3 objects, 2 permission sets with one `isDefault`, 3 datasets of 8 + 3 + 2 records), console via vite. On the base: clicking 安装 went straight to 处理中…, no dialog, POST at once. On this head: the confirm read 对象 3 / 权限集 2 / 示例记录 13 and the `acme_deals_user` suggestion with zero POSTs; after its 安装, the install answer's `seeded` was `inline`, `inserted: 13`. The manifest GET count was the same on both runs (2, the dev build's double effect), so the confirm adds no request. Screenshots and network logs: project files `issue-30325/`.
- HotCRM itself was not installed here (no cloud reachable from the container); its published bundle is flattened by its `publish-marketplace.mjs` (`flattenArtifact`), the shape covered by the first case.
- Same class, not in this PR: the catalog page's organization-package Install (`MarketplacePage.tsx` `doOrgInstall`) also posts install-local on one click with no confirm (read in code, not run). Reported to the seat.
- The cloud install dialog is unchanged: it keeps its own environment picker and sample-data checkbox.
